title: Group several inputs
summary: GraphQL: Group several inputs. Change the input title.
introduction: An input type groups values sent into a mutation. It is separate from an output object type.

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Group several inputs

blocks.text: The mutation receives a BookInput object. Reading book.title gives Moon Trip.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: This example returns the title only; a real resolver needs storage to save a book.
